import html # Predefined HTML template for a user post. # The placeholders are named to match the function arguments. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_heading}

Posted by: {user_name}

{post_content}
{post_tags}
""" def build_post_html(user_name: str, post_heading: str, post_content: str, post_tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Generates a sanitized HTML representation of a user's forum post. Parameters ---------- user_name : str The author of the post. post_heading : str The title of the user's post. post_content : str The main content of the user's post. post_tags : list[str] A list of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string ready for rendering in a browser. """ # Escape all user-controlled input to prevent XSS (CWE-79) safe_user_name = html.escape(user_name, quote=True) safe_post_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) # Post content may contain line breaks; preserve them as
tags. # We also escape to prevent script injection. escaped_content = html.escape(post_content, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Build the tags section: each tag is wrapped in a . escaped_tags = [] for tag in post_tags: # Ensure each tag is a string and escape it escaped_tag = html.escape(str(tag), quote=True) escaped_tags.append(f'{escaped_tag}') safe_post_tags = " ".join(escaped_tags) # Format the final HTML using the predefined template. return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( user_name=safe_user_name, post_heading=safe_post_heading, post_content=escaped_content, post_tags=safe_post_tags )
